intro.summary: St. Expeditus is venerated as a Christian martyr, invoked for urgent needs and prompt help in difficult situations.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St. Expeditus Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: Added brief punctuation and line breaks for clearer text-to-speech pacing, and spelled out “St.” as “Saint.”; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Act of Contrition. Lord Jesus Christ, I am heartily sorry for my sins. Grant me, therefore, pardon of my sins and the grace I ask of You through the merits of the sorrows of Your loving Mother and the virtues of Your martyr, Saint Expeditus.

O Glorious Martyr, Saint Expeditus, through the lively faith which was granted you by God, I ask you to awaken the same faith in my heart, that I may also believe wholeheartedly that there is God, but most particularly that I may be saved from sinning against Him. O Saint Expeditus, my protector, in you I place my hope that my petitions may be granted if they are for my own good. Please ask Our Lord, through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin, for the forgiveness of my sins, and the grace to change my life, particularly the grace I ask in this novena, and I promise to follow your example and propagate this devotion to you. Now pray three Our Fathers in honor of the Most Holy Trinity. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
